Allows RestartNow to automatically perform system reboot without Root access.

To allow RestartNow to reboot your device automatically without Root access, please turn ON \"RestartNow\" in Accessibility settings.\n\n(This 1-time setup remains permanently enabled across all future reboots).

RestartNow v2.0 (2026)

Universal 1-Touch System Reboot Utility for Android phones, tablets, and Automotive HeadUnits.

• Engine: Dual-Action No-Root Architecture (Automotive Broadcast + Accessibility Gesture)
• Screen Support: Adaptive Landscape & Portrait
• Developer: LamDien
• License: Open Source (MIT License)
• Privacy: Zero personal data collected.
